mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that may prompt aggressive monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5, or the signal fails to outperform a random walk in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and consumer spending indicate a weakening demand environment, triggering a flight to quality and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0), the economy enters a recessionary regime where equity valuations contract, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In the defined recessionary regime, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the regime-specific return is not significantly different from the overall average (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past quarter signals strong household demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that may lead to an early Fed rate hike, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL (yoy) > 3.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market with rising employment (PAYEMS > 130,000) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 8.0), the economy is in a late-cycle expansion where equity valuations become stretched, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the regime-specific return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
